submittedDate.start: inclusive from the first second of the start minute
submittedDate.end: exclusive: [A TO B] stops before B:00 (a paper at 18:59:26 is in [1859 TO 1900] and not in [1859 TO 1859] or [1858 TO 1859])
submittedDate.consequence: query from the previous deadline minute TO the deadline minute itself (14:00 ET as HHMM UTC), not one minute before; arXiv blog notices also say "at or after 14:00 ... and before 14:00"
